app.name: Tautua

app.principle.context: The guiding principle of Samoan life, and the spirit of this reference.

review.title: Export for matai review
review.subtitle: Export every bilingual entry as a clean markdown document for matai review before public release. Entries flagged as varying by nuʻu are called out for specific attention.
review.previewNote: A preview of the full bilingual export. Print or download for review.
review.corrections.title: How corrections are applied
review.corrections.step1: Send this exported document to a matai, faifeʻau, or cultural advisor for review.
review.corrections.step2b: as a patch entry per id.
review.corrections.step3: Once a patch is applied with status approved, the Community Reviewed badge appears on that entry across the app.
